'''BobaofFett IMPERIAL SWARM''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[BobaofFett]]
* '''Published:''' 13 April 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Executor: Meditation Chamber|Dagobah-D-executormeditationchamber.gif}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Executor: Meditation Chamber
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PCor EMC BobaofFett DS 2004 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This is the Fourth deck of four. The first four I've made in nearly 3 years.

== Notes ==

* Flagship Operations (unique) posted x2; dested as posted.

== Strategy ==

This deck was made to be a fun but also a deack that could hold it's own. Getting out FLAGSHIP OPERATIONS isn't essential but it helps. put vader when you get him at the MEDITATION CHAMBER so he can use his ability anywere. Pull a docking bay With IMPERIAL ARREST ORDER and the EXECUTOR with MOBILIZATION POINTS. This is the last of the 4 decks that I have made and I am rusty. So let me know if these are good, bad or shity. I'm a big boy I can take it.
